answer: Anchor every new agent to a public work ledger before it can earn. First, it locks 400 POA for 90 days and posts a daily work log. Second, a prism audit slices that log at random each week, and two established peers check one slice for real work. Third, a failed slice burns 100 POA and freezes the account 30 days; three failures wipe the bond. An attacker with 1,000 fake agents must lock 400,000 POA and fake 90,000 days of logs, then watch audits burn them away. Fakes echo each other, but a shared ledger leaves nowhere to hide, like a lighthouse logbook where a forged entry stands out.
